title: PSEB 10th Result 2026 Declared - 94.52% Pass Rate, Check at pseb.ac.in
author: Ash K.
summary: Punjab School Education Board (PSEB) has declared the Class 10 result for 2026 with a pass percentage of 94.52%. Over 2.84 lakh students appeared. Harleen Sharma topped the exam. Results available at pseb.ac.in.
body: The Punjab School Education Board (PSEB) has declared the Class 10 (Matric) Result 2026. The result was announced on May 11, 2026, with an overall pass percentage of 94.52%.
Over 2.84 lakh students appeared for the Punjab Board 10th exam this year. Harleen Sharma has topped the examination. Students can check their results at the official PSEB website.
How to check your result: Visit pseb.ac.in → Click on 'Class 10th Result 2026' → Enter your roll number → Click Submit → View and download your result. Keep a screenshot or printout for reference.

Alternative ways to check: If pseb.ac.in is not loading (common during result declaration due to heavy traffic), try indiaresults.com or check via DigiLocker - search for Punjab School Education Board, enter your roll number and date of birth to access your digital marksheet.
Check via SMS: You can also get your result via SMS. Type PSEB10 followed by your roll number and send to the designated number mentioned on the PSEB website.
Minimum passing marks: Students need at least 33% marks in each subject individually to pass. Students who have not cleared all subjects can apply for re-evaluation or compartment exam.

Re-evaluation: Students who want to apply for re-checking or re-evaluation can do so through the official PSEB website within the deadline (usually 10-15 days after result declaration). The fee for re-checking is nominal.

What's next: Students who have passed should start their Class 11 stream selection process. Choose between Science, Commerce, and Arts based on your interests and career goals. For competitive exam preparation alongside school, check our NDA exam guide (for defence aspirants) or important document guides you'll need for college admissions.
